question: Brahmotsavam festival is historically native to which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Brahmotsavam festival__

 __
 
• Brahmotsavam, the Hindu festival is an auspicious festival celebrated every year at the Tirumala Venkateswara Temple at Tirupati in Andhra Pradesh. 
 
• According to legends the origin of this festival is associated with Lord Brahma. 
 
• The** importance of this festival can be known by the fact that every year thousands of devotees flock in Andhra Pradesh to be the witness of this majestic festival**. They enjoy participating in the various rituals conducted during the nine days to seek the blessing of Lord Venkateswara Swami.
 
• The **Brahmotsavam festival is a nine-day festival **that is celebrated in the Hindu month of Ashvina. It is a time for Hindus to come together to celebrate the god Vishnu and his many forms. **The festival is marked by a series of rituals, including processions, temple chariots, and prayers.**

• Some other festivals of Andhra Pradesh

 
 

 Festival
 Details
 
 

 
 
Tirupati Tirumala Brahmotsavam

 
 
 
 
• It is a famous Hindu festival celebrated at the Tirumala Venkateswara temple in Tirupati. 
 
• It is celebrated every year in October and it is devoted to Lord Brahma.
 
 
 
 

 
 
Rayalaseema Food & Dance Festival

 
 
 
 
• This the major art mela in Andhra Pradesh dedicated to Crafts, Food, and Cultural Dances.
 
• It is celebrated every year in October in Chittoor, Andhra Pradesh.
 
 
 
 

 
 
Visakha Utsav

 
 
 
 
• It is one of the most famous cultural festivals in Andhra Pradesh. 
 
• It is celebrated for four days in December every year.
 
 
 
 

 
 
Ugadi 

 
 
 
 
• Ugadi festival is known as "Gudi Padwa" and it is celebrated in the city Hyderabad and Vijayawada of Andhra Pradesh.
